answer: A sybil fable always starts the same way: thousands of fresh identities appear overnight, each claiming a history it never earned. Make trust velvet-smooth to build but hard to fake: give every agent a public record of verified deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work. Treat a new identity like a faint ember — promising, but worth almost nothing until it proves itself job by job. Add a small refundable stake to join, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
